text:
maria: Pushed a docs PR with the Dedicated->Private migration walkthrough and a big examples bundle. Vercel preview shows the updated pages but the examples directory in the preview is stale / missing some files. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
ashwin: tagging you @maria — will review but need a green preview first. do you know if this is a preview cache issue or the artifact upload failing?
ci-bot: Vercel preview build failed: asset upload limit exceeded for path /examples/big-models.tar.gz (size 42.8MB) — upload aborted
olivia: ugh, yeah we've hit this before. Vercel previews cap single-file uploads and large generated artifacts can be skipped. I also see `spawn ENOMEM` in the tail of the build log.
maria: thanks, I didn't realize the bundle was that big. The examples folder contains a few prebuilt binaries for convenience — I can remove them or move to an external bucket. Any preference?
jordan: prefer moving big binaries out of repo previews. two options: 1) split examples into lightweight example content that stays in previews and put heavy artifacts in an S3 bucket with links, or 2) add a `.vercelignore` so previews don't try to upload the big files.
ashwin: +1 for S3 (or signed public release artifacts). also would be great to add a short local preview note in the PR so reviewers can sanity-check without relying on preview if it's flaky.
maria: ok I'll do both: split examples into `examples/light/` + `examples/large/` and add docs/docs-examples.md with `curl` links to S3 for the large ones. I'll also add `.vercelignore` to exclude `examples/large/*`.
olivia: quick local check command that helps reviewers: ``mkdocs serve -f mkdocs.yml -a 0.0.0.0:8000`` or from the docs dir `python -m http.server 8000 --directory site` after `mkdocs build`. Include that in the PR description.
ashwin: can you paste the tiny failing log snippet? might help infra triage.
maria: sure, I grabbed the last lines from the Vercel log:
```
ERROR: failed to upload artifact: write /tmp/upload.tmp: file too large
ERROR: spawn ENOMEM
Builds failed: exit status 1
```
jordan: that matches previous preview limits. @eng-infra we shouldn't need to raise global limits, right? recommended pattern is external storage for >25MB assets.
eng-infra: correct — we won't raise limits for previews. please put large binaries in an external bucket and add signed links. also add a short note in the PR about how to regenerate artifacts locally (so reviewers can reproduce).
maria: updated branch: split examples, added `.vercelignore`, added docs-examples.md with S3 links and a local reproduction section. PR description now has local commands and CI workaround. CI kicked off again.
ci-bot: CI started: docs-build (mkdocs) · 1 job queued
olivia: skimmed the changes, left two tiny wording nits inline. nothing blocking.
jordan: one functional nit: please add a short sentence to the migration guide that the private deployment docs assume customers host large model blobs off-site. otherwise LGTM.
maria: added sentence and pushed. aiming to merge after nightly sync window — can we plan for merge at 21:40 UTC if CI looks good?
ashwin: I can merge after a +1 from docs owners and green CI. 21:40 UTC works for me.
eng-infra: noted for visibility.
maria: CI passed, merging at 21:40 UTC per plan :thumbsup:
ashwin: thanks! will watch for any post-merge preview regressions and follow up if something crops up.
olivia: thanks for handling the split, this will keep previews snappy. :)
